description: A curated data set of P-space representations for 51 metro networks worldwide is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Sam Vijlbrief, Oded Cats. A curated data set of P-space representations in .json format for 51 metro networks worldwide. The creation of this data set was part of the MSc thesis referenced below. The goal for the data was to create a set of topological representations based on GTFS data that is curated and verified. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
